pages.text: From the $(l)Heralds$() phase, the Pestilence has servants: people, or what is left of them, each doing a job for the sickness. They walk at night and come out of mature nests.$(br2)Learn what each one does; it tells you which to kill first.

pages.name: Plague Bearer
pages.text: Rings a handbell you will hear long before you see it, and leaves bodies behind. Burn them.

pages.name: Gravedigger
pages.text: Tends the dead with its shovel: corpses it reaches rise far sooner.

pages.name: Flagellant
pages.text: Whips itself, and every Herald and Afflicted near it grows stronger and faster. Kill it first.

pages.name: Censer Monk
pages.text: Its censer leaves miasma behind it and blights the ground it walks.

pages.name: Ratcatcher
pages.text: Keeps its distance and whistles up rats. Rush it.

pages.name: Mourner
pages.text: Weeps, and fills those near it with $(l)Dread$(): no running.

pages.name: Bone Collector
pages.text: Steals the dead and carries them to the nests, which grow on them. Killing it drops what it carried.

pages.name: Miasma Wraith
pages.text: Arrows pass through it. Its touch brings pneumonic plague and $(l)Delirium$(). Fire hurts it double; brazier or censer smoke tears it apart.

pages.name: Pustule
pages.text: Never moves. Strike it up close, or stand by it once swollen, and it bursts into miasma. Shoot it.
